title: EventEnvelope
description: Host-stamped event delivered to each matching subscriber, without replay guarantees.

bot.description: Authenticated source account and adapter instance.

event_id.description: Host-local event correlation ID; not an upstream deduplication key.

payload.description: Original protocol JSON, including extension fields.

received_at_ms.description: Host receive time since Unix epoch in milliseconds.

BotRef.description: An account attached to one host-assigned adapter instance (including its generation).

adapter_instance_id.description: Host-assigned adapter instance ID; never a plugin-selected routing identity.

self_id.description: Protocol account identifier represented as a string without precision loss.
